Header: MENA M&A reaches $46.7bn in H1 as Q2 deal value doubles
News: Arab News reports that Middle East and North Africa completed 390 mergers and acquisitions worth $46.7 billion in the first half of 2026, with second-quarter deal value more than doubling amid resilient activity in Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Header: Saudi Arabia M&A activity rises to 24 deals in Q1 worth $689m
News: Arab News details that Saudi Arabia recorded 24 mergers and acquisitions in the first quarter of 2026 totaling $689 million, highlighting continued investor interest across sectors including financial services and technology. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/tags/mergers-and-acquisitions))

Header: Saudi Arabia leads GCC dealmaking as M&A strengthens
News: Arab News explains that Saudi Arabia has emerged as the leading Gulf Cooperation Council market for mergers and acquisitions, supported by economic reforms and strong cross-border deal flows, as regional activity continues to strengthen. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/tags/mergers-and-acquisitions))

Header: Gulf sovereign funds fuel global M&A boom, driving deal value to $3.5tn
News: Arab News, citing Asharq Bloomberg, says Middle East and Asian sovereign wealth funds are powering a global mergers and acquisitions surge, with deal values exceeding $3.5 trillion and Gulf investors increasingly targeting international assets. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2619814/business-economy))

Header: MENA mergers and acquisitions activity surges in H1 with $59bn in deals: EY
News: Arab News reports that MENA M&A deal value rose 19% to about $59 billion in the first half of 2025, with chemicals and technology dominating cross-border transactions and the UAE and Saudi Arabia driving the bulk of activity. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2612297/business-economy))

Header: Riyadh-based cyber economics center sets research priorities as threats grow
News: Arab News reports that the Centre for Cyber Economics, a joint initiative between the Global Cybersecurity Forum and the World Economic Forum, has set out research priorities to better understand the economic impact of cyber threats and guide global policy responses. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2651898/saudi-arabia))

Header: Saudi Arabia maintains leading cybersecurity ranking for third consecutive year
News: According to Arab News, Saudi Arabia has retained its top position in the IMD World Competitiveness Yearbook’s cybersecurity index and is classified as a “role‑modeling” nation in the UN’s Global Cybersecurity Index 2026, reflecting rapid sector development under the National Cybersecurity Authority. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2647718/saudi-arabia))

Header: UN expands global cybersecurity network with new office in Saudi Arabia
News: Arab News details how the UN Institute for Training and Research has opened its first office dedicated to cybersecurity in Riyadh, creating a global hub to build cyber resilience through training, research, and policy support. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2646855/saudi-arabia))
